description: Filters Santa's vetted 212 hand-checked gift ideas - the Secret Santa subset of the shared 255-idea bank it shares with its sister site The Present Picker, sorted here for Secret Santa by the budget band your group agreed for its draw - with strict parameters, and returns up to three picks. Parameters: budget_band (required: under_25, 25_to_50, 50_to_100, over_100); recipient_type (anyone, kid - only ideas from the bank's Kid shelf, or adult - everything except the Kid shelf); one interest hint (books, cooking, cozy, fitness, games, gardening, music, outdoors, science, tech, travel, or surprise) which ranks matches first; and avoid, a list of words - any idea whose name, blurb, or why mentions an avoid word is excluded, and the answer says how many ideas the filters set aside. Each pick names the kind of gift, why it fits, and what to look for and avoid. No brands, no stores, no exact prices: budget bands are guides, not exact prices. This tool never asks who the gift is for by name and knows nothing about any draw.

avoid.description: Words to exclude: any idea whose name, blurb, or why mentions one of these words is filtered out (for example "coffee" or "scented").

interest.description: One interest hint for the person, or surprise for any.

recipient_type.description: Who the gift is for: kid returns only the bank's Kid-shelf ideas; adult excludes them; anyone (default) applies no recipient filter.

name: pick_secret_santa_gift
title: Pick a Secret Santa gift
